name: Despair Legendary Domain
body:
The domain of despair is one of taking away hopes and reveling in causing hopelessness. As a cleric of the despair domain, you are an individual that enjoys dashing the hopes of others and using it for your own gain.

Divine Skill: Intimidate

Dashing of Hopes (Su)

As an immediate action when you reduce a creature below 0 hit points, you can spend 1 point of faith to release a burst of dread and despair.

All enemies within 30 feet must make a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 your legendary cleric level + your Wisdom modifier) or be subject to the doubting condition. If the enemy is half your HD or less they are instead despairing. This condition lasts for 1d4 rounds and is a mind-affecting, emotion, despair effect. This does not allow you to increase the condition of a target above the listed effect.

Hope Eater (Su)

At 4th level you may spend 1 faith point as a standard action to cause a target within 30 feet with the doubting or despairing condition to have their condition worsened and feed off that despair. The target must make a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 your cleric level + your Wisdom modifier) or have their condition worsened from doubting to despairing or despairing to hopeless. This has no effect on creatures already subject to the hopeless condition. On a failed saving throw by the target you gain the benefits of the spell death knell for 10 minutes. This is a mind-affecting, emotion, despair effect.

Aura of Despair (Su)

At 8th level, you may expend 1 point of faith to create a 30 ft. aura of despair for 1 round per class level. All creatures, including yourself, within the aura have a penalty on saves vs, despair effects equal to 1/4 your class level. This is a mind-affecting, emotion, despair effect.

Domain Spells: 1st-lesser crushing despair, 2nd-lesser symbol of despair, 3rd–crushing despair (modified), 4th-symbol of despair, 5th-hopeless shadow, 6th-greater crushing despair, 7th-greater symbol of despair, 8th–unholy aura, 9th-aspect of the hope devourer

Doctrine of Isolation

For some, being isolated and cut off from your companions causes immense dread. You exploit this to great effect.

Blinding Dread (Su)

You may spend 1 point of faith when casting a spell with the despair descriptor. If you do and the target(s) fails their will save they are allowed a second Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 your cleric level + your Wisdom modifier) or be blinded for the duration of the spell effect. If the spell is instantaneous, the blinding effect lasts for 1 round per class level.

Aura of Hopeless Isolation (Su)

At 16th level, you gain the ability to create an aura that enhances the dread felt when isolated from you allies. By expending 1 point of faith as a standard action you may create a 60 foot aura that lasts for a number of rounds equal to your class level. Any creature who is within the aura who is unable to touch or see an ally, due to darkness, blindness, being out of sight, or obscured, must make a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 your cleric level + your Wisdom modifier) or be inflicted with the doubting condition or have an existing despair condition increased by one level. Each round the creature remains in the aura without an ally in sight or in touch range, they must continue to roll Will saves or have the condition worsen. The condition or increase to the condition lasts for as long as the creature is in the aura and unable to see or touch an ally. If the creature is able to see an ally or touch them the condition does not worsen that round and if the creature leaves the aura, their condition lowers by one each round to a minimum of any underlying conditions they are subject to. This is a mind-affecting, emotion and despair effect.

Doctrine of Paranoia

When people feel dejected and outcast, in their hopelessness, some lash out with hatred, distrust and paranoia. You can leverage and induce this reaction to your great benefit.

Cause Distrust (Su)

When using your dashing hopes ability you also cause your enemies to blame each other for the defeat of their ally on a failed save. In addition to the doubting condition the enemies are unable to receive the benefits of teamwork. Teamwork benefits in this case include flanking, aid another or teamwork feats. They are still able to provide flanking bonuses to unaffected allies.

Hopeless Paranoia (Su)

At 16th level, you may spend 1 point of faith as a standard action to create a 30 ft. aura of hopeless paranoia. The aura lasts for 1 round per class level. Any creature who is within aura and is currently afflicted by a despair condition must make a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 your cleric level + your Wisdom modifier). On a failed save they get a feeling of intense paranoia. Afflicted creatures are unable to receive teamwork benefits (see cause distrust above) and they must take attack of opportunities against any allies that provoke them, if applicable. On a successful save, the creatures are unaffected. Anytime the creature is subject to a new despair condition while in the aura or leave and reenter the aura they must make a save against this effect. This is a mind-affecting, emotion and despair effect.
